tooltip.jdte.capacity: Doubles energy and fluid capacity; Greenhouses also gain one output page and a higher slot limit.
tooltip.jdte.overclock: Forces 1 tick operation and runs twice per tick. Energy cost is tripled.
tooltip.jdte.underclock: Forces 40 tick operation. Energy cost is reduced by 80%.
tooltip.jdte.fluid_storage: Clicker only. Adds an internal fluid tank that automatically fills fluid-containing items in the clicker slot.
tooltip.jdte.generator: Generator only. Consumes twice the fuel input for triple generation.
tooltip.jdte.range: Area machines only. Doubles the configurable area limit.
tooltip.jdte.filter: Adds an extra row of filter slots.
tooltip.jdte.creative: Machine operates without FE cost. Time Accelerator operates without fluid cost. Includes overclock effect.
tooltip.jdte.fortune: Greenhouses: +10% average output; other supported machines: Fortune +1.
tooltip.jdte.precision: Crystal Incubator only. Harvests crystals through vanilla Silk Touch loot logic; incompatible with Fortune.
tooltip.jdte.ae_acceleration: Time Accelerator tiers only. Allows this machine to accelerate AE2 devices that expose IGridTickable services.
tooltip.jdte.ae_output: Bind in a Wireless Access Point UI, then install in a machine with item or fluid outputs to return products directly to that AE network.
tooltip.jdte.ae_output.unlinked: Unlinked — insert into a Wireless Access Point UI
tooltip.jdte.essence_conversion: Greenhouses only. Crafts harvested Mystical Agriculture essences when they have exactly one essence-only crafting recipe.
tooltip.jdte.seed_conversion: Greenhouses only. Replaces harvested copies of the planted Mystical Agriculture seed with its essence.
tooltip.jdte.extended_upgrade: Right-click a JDT T2 machine to upgrade it to an extended version (8 upgrade slots).
tooltip.jdte.large_greenhouse.io: All base-layer faces accept plant templates, recipe fluid, and energy. Products enter internal storage before pipes or Auto I/O export them. Batched production uses 1/9 the recipe fluid required for the same harvests in a Greenhouse.
jei.jdte.gel_generator.description: Converts input blocks into items and fluids using gel and fuel
tooltip.jdte.life_apple: A product of concentrated life. Eating it may have a unique effect...
jei.jdte.life_apple.info: Life Apples permanently strengthen the player with no consumption cap.
jei.jdte.wither_essence.info: Has a 5% base chance to drop in addition to normal loot when a Bio Crusher kills a Wither; it does not replace the Nether Star. Looting only increases the amount after a successful roll. Infuse it with 64 B of Life Fluid to create a Wither Spawn Egg.
jei.jdte.ender_dragon_essence.info: Has a 10% base chance to drop in addition to normal loot when a Bio Crusher kills an Ender Dragon. Looting only increases the amount after a successful roll. Infuse it with 64 B of Life Fluid to create an Ender Dragon Spawn Egg.
jei.jdte.elder_guardian_essence.info: Drops in addition to normal loot when a Bio Crusher kills an Elder Guardian. Looting may increase the amount. Infuse it with 64 B of Life Fluid to create an Elder Guardian Spawn Egg.
